scope: Disposable loopback PostgreSQL; wrapper-level administrative revocation regressions

cases.name: Empty revocation reason is rejected before state change
cases.precondition: Fresh migrated disposable database with one tenant and workspace
steps: Call revokeSkill with an empty reason
cases.expected: EMPTY_REASON; zero revocation rows and events

cases.name: workloom_app cannot pass as administrative owner
cases.precondition: Fresh migrated disposable database with one tenant and workspace
steps: Call revokeSkill with workloom_app pool and forged owner attribution
cases.expected: OWNER_CHANNEL_REQUIRED; no revocation or audit event

cases.name: workloom_gateway cannot pass as administrative owner
cases.precondition: Fresh migrated disposable database with one tenant and workspace
steps: Call revokeSkill with workloom_gateway pool and forged owner attribution
cases.expected: OWNER_CHANNEL_REQUIRED; no revocation or audit event

cases.name: Explicit owner pool atomically commits revocation and audit event
cases.precondition: Fresh migrated disposable database with one tenant and workspace
cases.expected: First result deduped=false; exactly one row and one consistent event

cases.name: Repeat owner revocation preserves first attribution and emits no duplicate
cases.precondition: Fresh migrated disposable database with one tenant and workspace
steps: Revoke the same skill with another reason and actor
Read original row and event count
cases.expected: deduped=true; first reason and actor retained; one event

cases.name: Twenty owner calls racing for one skill commit once
cases.precondition: Fresh migrated disposable database with one tenant and workspace
steps: Count first-write results and committed events
cases.expected: Exactly one deduped=false; one revocation; one event

cases.name: Audit-event validation failure rolls back the revocation
cases.precondition: Fresh migrated disposable database with one tenant and workspace
steps: Call revokeSkill with empty actor attribution to fail business-event schema
cases.expected: Call rejects; zero revocation rows and events
